description: Wearing an elytra, glide from 14 blocks up into a two-deep pool (x 4 to 26): the glide goes on in the water (the server ends it only on the ground), so sneak down to the pool's floor to end it. Then hold W and press jump every few ticks: in the water jump doesn't start a glide, but bobbing out of it at the surface it does, and that glide goes on in the water. Then swim to the pool's east edge and jump out onto the floor still pressing jump.

world.note: Fabric client gametest defaults: flat world, no structures, time and weather frozen, no mob spawning

build: item replace entity @a armor.chest with minecraft:elytra
harness: Fabric client gametest: one client tick per frame, one server tick per client tick
